title: Choosing a value for empty YAML entries
summary: The new YAML hook retained a caller-selected marker for an empty mapping and both null scalars. An empty sequence still became an empty string.

change.description: The YAML processor changes its protected two-argument flattening hook into a three-argument hook accepting a caller-selected empty value. The public properties factory retains its default policy.

notes: The adapter for each revision directly calls its protected overload. The common caller tests key presence and marker identity. The proposed uniform empty-container behavior was refuted.
